sections.text: Introduction

The purpose of the relay is basically to prevent damage on the turbine, if the 
 driving torque less than the total losses in the generator and the prime 
 mover, the generator starts to work as a synchronous compensator, taking the 
 necessary active power from the network. The total losses, as the percentage of the rated power, may vary approx, from 
 1 to 3 %

The reverse power relay is provide with one step. The relay shall be set at 1 
 % of the generator rated power and shall give an alarm and trip after a time 
 delay of 10 sec. The relay contains one directional current unit RXPE 40 and 
 one time delay unit.

The first draft of this document initiated by eng 
 Mohye El Deen Khames Ramadan from Esna Hyd. PS, HPSC-EP and tested at 
 14 May 2001
Safety Precautions

items: The line is out of service
Isolate the relay from PT`s & CT`s

Work
to be Carried Out
The line is out of service
Connect the circuit as shown in fig (1)
The voltage across the resistor R should be (5-10)v
Increase the current gradually until reach the operating value
Ensure that the relay operates at the setting current value (10)mA
Ensure that the relay operates at the setting tine value (10) sec
Repeat for phases S & T
Record this values on the test sheet

Take off the equipments and the wires, then return the relay to its normal 
position
